rationale: clk_mux = sel_i ? clk_b : clk_a is a combinational clock mux of two clock leaves (CDC-019 WARNING Unresolved) with a primary-input select (CDC-031 WARNING Unresolved). Reader A's note on the missing clk_b-mode boundary timing is a further undischarged assumption, consistent with unknown.

author_reading.rationale: Raw combinational 2:1 clock mux driven by a primary-input select feeds a register clock; no glitch-free mux structure is recognized and select synchronism is undecidable.

labels.rationale: A board select switches a combinational mux between asynchronous clock inputs. An input delay to clk_a provides neither safe switching relative to clk_b nor a glitch-free mode contract.
labels.suspected_flaw: Only clk_a is named in data and output timing. Switching restrictions and clk_b-mode boundary timing are unspecified.

labels.rationale: Net clk_mux switches combinationally between asynchronous clocks clk_a and clk_b via assign clk_mux = sel_i ? clk_b : clk_a (design.sv:12) under primary-input select sel_i, which is neither a recognized glitch-free clock mux cell (CDC-019 WARNING Unresolved) nor controlled by a select synchronous to both switched clocks (CDC-031 WARNING Unresolved).

settlement.rationale: clk_mux = sel_i ? clk_b : clk_a is a combinational clock mux of two clock leaves (CDC-019 WARNING Unresolved) with a primary-input select (CDC-031 WARNING Unresolved). Reader A's note on the missing clk_b-mode boundary timing is a further undischarged assumption, consistent with unknown.
